description: Order videos: give the brief (what the videos should say or show), who the creators should be, a timeline and a budget. CxB finds creators who look like the brand's customers, gets their yes and delivers the finished videos. Optionally pass a job_id from find_creators and the creator handles to start with. Needs the user's CxB account; the quote goes to its email. A person replies with a quote within a day; nothing is sent to creators until the quote is accepted. Returns a request_id.

brief.description: What the videos should say or show, e.g. "a nurse shows how she swaps a night shift in the app in under a minute".

country.description: Only if the user named a country. A preference: creators there rank first, but it isn't required. To require it, add it to must (e.g. "lives in the US").

deliverables.description: e.g. "one 30-second TikTok each, whitelisting for 60 days".

job_id.description: A find_creators job to draw creators from.

must.description: Requirements every match must show, e.g. ["works nights"]. Default: everything in `who`.

nice.description: Preferences that rank a creator higher but aren't required, e.g. ["B2B software"]. Moving a requirement here can multiply the matches.

platforms.description: Where to search: any of "tiktok", "instagram" (Reels), "youtube", "linkedin", or "all". Default ["tiktok"]. With several, the matches are shared out across them.

product_url.description: The product's website, if the user gave one.

who.description: Who the creators should be, in plain words: "ER nurses who work nights", "account executives at SaaS companies", "parents of kids with food allergies".

name: request_outreach
title: Order videos from creators
